mapper.select: SELECT o.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, o.ORDER_ID AS orderId, o.ORDERED_AT AS orderedAt, o.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, NVL(d.DELIVERY_STATUS, 'READY') AS deliveryStatus, oi.FIRST_PRODUCT_NAME AS firstProductName, oi.ITEM_COUNT AS itemCount, o.FINAL_AMOUNT AS finalAmount, oi.TOTAL_SAVED_AMOUNT AS totalSavedAmount FROM OFT_ORDERS o LEFT JOIN OFT_DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO JOIN ( SELECT agg.ORDER_NO, firstItem.PRODUCT_NAME AS FIRST_PRODUCT_NAME, agg.ITEM_COUNT, agg.TOTAL_SAVED_AMOUNT FROM ( SELECT ORDER_NO, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT, SUM(NVL(SAVED_AMOUNT, 0)) AS TOTAL_SAVED_AMOUNT, MIN(ORDER_ITEM_NO) AS FIRST_ORDER_ITEM_NO FROM OFT_ORDER_ITEM GROUP BY ORDER_NO ) agg JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM firstItem ON firstItem.ORDER_ITEM_NO = agg.FIRST_ORDER_ITEM_NO ) oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY o.ORDERED_AT DESC

SELECT o.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, o.ORDER_ID AS orderId, o.ORDERED_AT AS orderedAt, o.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, o.RECIPIENT_NAME AS recipientName, o.RECIPIENT_PHONE AS recipientPhone, o.ZIP_CODE AS zipCode, o.ADDRESS1 AS address1, o.ADDRESS2 AS address2, NVL(d.DELIVERY_STATUS, 'READY') AS deliveryStatus, d.COURIER_NAME AS courierName, d.TRACKING_NO AS trackingNo, d.DELIVERED_AT AS deliveredAt, p.PAYMENT_METHOD AS paymentMethod, p.PAYMENT_STATUS AS paymentStatus, p.PAID_AT AS paidAt, p.PAID_AMOUNT AS paidAmount, o.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, o.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT AS discountAmount, o.DELIVERY_FEE AS deliveryFee, o.FINAL_AMOUNT AS finalAmount FROM OFT_ORDERS o LEFT JOIN OFT_DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN OFT_PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND o.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}

SELECT oi.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS orderItemNo, oi.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, oi.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, oi.UNIT_PRICE AS unitPrice, oi.QUANTITY AS quantity, oi.SUBTOTAL AS subtotal, oi.MARKET_AVG_PRICE AS marketAvgPrice, oi.SAVED_AMOUNT AS savedAmount, oi.SAVING_RATE AS savingRate, r.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo FROM OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi LEFT JOIN OFT_REVIEW r ON r.ORDER_ITEM_NO = oi.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND r.PRODUCT_NO = oi.PRODUCT_NO AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE oi.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} ORDER BY oi.ORDER_ITEM_NO ASC
